## Buy earbuds and headphones in Nepal

Good audio makes a daily commute, a workout or a long day of calls far more pleasant. Our audio section covers every style: true wireless earbuds, neckband earphones, wired earphones and over-ear or on-ear headphones.

## Picking the right style

- TWS earbuds: completely wireless and pocketable, with a charging case
- Neckbands: wireless with a band around the neck, long battery life and less risk of losing an earbud
- Wired earphones: no charging, no lag, and the best value for sound quality
- Headphones: the most comfortable for long sessions and usually the best sound and noise cancellation

## Features worth comparing

- Active noise cancellation (ANC) for traffic, buses and flights
- Battery life of the earbuds and the case together
- Microphone quality for calls and online meetings
- Codec support such as AAC or LDAC for better wireless sound
- Water resistance (IPX4 or higher) for workouts and rain

All audio products we sell are genuine, so the sound and battery life match what the brand advertises.

faqs.question: What is the difference between TWS earbuds and neckbands?
faqs.answer: TWS earbuds are fully wireless and charge in a case, making them very compact. Neckbands connect the two earpieces with a band that sits around your neck, which usually gives longer battery life and makes them harder to lose.

faqs.question: Is noise cancellation worth it?
faqs.answer: If you travel on buses, work in a noisy place or fly often, yes. Active noise cancellation reduces constant background noise so you can listen at a lower, safer volume.

faqs.question: Will these earbuds work with both Android and iPhone?
faqs.answer: Bluetooth earbuds and headphones work with both. Some features, such as companion apps or special codecs, may work best on one platform; the product page mentions this where it matters.

faqs.question: Can I return earbuds after opening them?
faqs.answer: For hygiene reasons, opened or used in-ear products may not be eligible for return. Unused items in their original packaging can be returned within 7 days of delivery.

seoDescription: Buy genuine wireless earbuds in Nepal: TWS earbuds with ANC, long battery life and clear calls. Original brands, cash on delivery.
seoContent:
## Buy wireless earbuds in Nepal

True wireless (TWS) earbuds have become the default way to listen on the go. There are no wires at all: the earbuds connect over Bluetooth and recharge in a pocket-sized case. The difference between a cheap pair and a good one shows up in sound, call quality, battery life and connection stability.

## How to choose wireless earbuds

- Fit: earbuds with several ear-tip sizes seal better, which improves bass and noise cancellation
- ANC: active noise cancellation cuts traffic and engine noise; transparency mode lets you hear announcements
- Battery: compare earbud battery life and total life with the case; 6 hours per charge is a good benchmark
- Calls: multiple microphones with noise reduction make calls clearer in busy streets
- Latency: a low-latency or game mode helps with videos and mobile games
- Water resistance: IPX4 or higher for workouts and rain
- Bluetooth version: 5.3 and newer connect faster and hold the connection better

Our TWS earbuds are genuine products from established audio brands. Specifications, battery figures and what is in the box are on each product page.

faqs.question: How long do TWS earbuds last on a charge?
faqs.answer: Most earbuds last 5 to 8 hours per charge, and the case adds another two to four full charges. Using ANC or high volume shortens battery life; each product page lists the brand's figures.

faqs.question: Are TWS earbuds good for phone calls?
faqs.answer: Good ones are. Look for models with multiple microphones and call noise reduction. Budget earbuds often sound fine for music but pick up a lot of background noise on calls.

faqs.question: Can I use TWS earbuds for gaming?
faqs.answer: Yes, but choose a model with a low-latency or game mode. Standard Bluetooth adds a small delay that you may notice in fast mobile games.

faqs.question: How do I know my earbuds are genuine?
faqs.answer: Buy from a trusted seller. Copies of popular earbuds are common in Nepal and often have poor sound, weak batteries and no real noise cancellation. Every pair at 361 Gadgets is a genuine product.

seoContent:
## Buy neckband earphones in Nepal

Neckband earphones are a practical choice for people who wear earphones all day. The band rests around your neck, so when you take the earbuds out they simply hang there instead of going into a case or getting lost. The larger body also holds a bigger battery than most true wireless earbuds.

## Why choose a neckband

- Long battery life, often 20 hours or more on one charge
- Fast charging: many give several hours of playback from a 10-minute charge
- Magnetic earbuds that clip together and can pause music
- Hard to lose, which makes them good for commuting, running and riding
- Physical buttons for volume, calls and tracks

## What to compare

Look at battery life, charging port (USB-C is the most convenient), water resistance for workouts and whether the model supports connecting to two devices at once. All neckbands we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Are neckbands better than TWS earbuds?
faqs.answer: They suit different people. Neckbands usually have longer battery life, physical buttons and are hard to lose. TWS earbuds are smaller and fit in a pocket. If you wear earphones for most of the day, a neckband is often more practical.

faqs.question: Can I use a neckband while running or riding?
faqs.answer: Yes. The band keeps the earphones secure, and many models are sweat resistant. On a bike or scooter, keep the volume low so you can still hear traffic.

faqs.question: How long does a neckband take to charge?
faqs.answer: Most charge fully in one to two hours, and many support quick charging that gives several hours of music from about 10 minutes. Check the product page for each model's figures.

seoDescription: Buy genuine wired earphones in Nepal: USB-C, Lightning and 3.5 mm earphones with mic for clear calls and great sound value.
seoContent:
## Buy wired earphones in Nepal

Wired earphones are still the best value in audio. They never need charging, have no Bluetooth delay and usually sound better than wireless earbuds at the same price. They are also handy as a dependable backup for calls and online classes.

## Choose the right connector

- 3.5 mm jack: works with laptops, older phones, tablets and many gaming controllers
- USB-C: for recent Android phones and iPhone 15 or newer models without a headphone jack
- Lightning: for iPhone models from the iPhone 7 up to the iPhone 14 series

## What else to look for

- An inline microphone and remote for calls and music control
- A tangle-resistant or braided cable that lasts longer
- Comfortable ear tips in several sizes

All wired earphones at 361 Gadgets are genuine, with the connector type listed clearly on each product page.

faqs.question: Will USB-C earphones work with every USB-C phone?
faqs.answer: Most recent phones support USB-C audio, but a few older models do not. If your phone came without a headphone jack and supports USB-C audio adapters, USB-C earphones will work.

faqs.question: Are wired earphones better for gaming?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wired earphones have no wireless delay, so sound stays in sync with what is on screen, which matters in fast mobile and PC games.

faqs.question: Do wired earphones work for online classes and calls?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as they have an inline microphone. Most models listed here include a mic; check the product page to confirm.

seoContent:
## Buy headphones in Nepal

Headphones are the most comfortable way to listen for hours at a time. Over-ear and on-ear designs have bigger drivers than earbuds, which means fuller sound, and the best wireless models block out noise remarkably well.

## Over-ear vs on-ear

- Over-ear headphones surround your ears, isolate noise better and are the most comfortable for long sessions
- On-ear headphones are smaller and lighter, and fold away more easily for travel

## Features to compare

- Active noise cancellation for flights, buses and open offices
- Battery life: 30 hours or more is common on good wireless models
- Multipoint pairing to switch between laptop and phone
- A wired option (3.5 mm) for when the battery runs out
- Comfort: weight, clamping force and ear-cushion material all matter on long days

Whether you need headphones for music, study, work calls or travel, every pair we sell is genuine.

faqs.question: Are noise-cancelling headphones good for studying?
faqs.answer: Yes. Active noise cancellation reduces constant noise such as traffic, generators and chatter, which helps you concentrate without turning the volume up.

faqs.question: Can I use wireless headphones with a cable?
faqs.answer: Many wireless headphones include a 3.5 mm cable so you can keep listening when the battery is flat or connect to a device without Bluetooth. The product page lists what is included.

faqs.question: Are headphones better than earbuds for long use?
faqs.answer: For many people, yes. Headphones do not sit inside the ear canal, so they can be more comfortable over several hours, and they usually offer longer battery life.

A good speaker turns any room, rooftop or picnic into a place for music. From pocket-size portable speakers to big party speakers with deep bass, the right choice depends on where and how you listen.

## How to choose a speaker

- Size and power: small speakers for personal listening, larger ones for living rooms and gatherings
- Battery life: 10 hours or more for days out and power cuts
- Water and dust resistance: IP67 speakers survive rain, dust and splashes
- Stereo pairing: connect two speakers for wider sound
- Smart features: voice assistants and Wi-Fi streaming on smart speakers
- Connections: Bluetooth, aux input and USB-C charging

All speakers we sell are genuine, so you get the sound and battery life the brand promises.

faqs.question: How long does a Bluetooth speaker battery last?
faqs.answer: Most portable speakers last between 8 and 24 hours depending on size and volume. Playing loudly drains the battery faster. Each product page lists the brand's figures.

seoDescription: Shop genuine soundbars in Nepal for clearer TV dialogue and cinematic sound, with subwoofers, Dolby Audio and HDMI ARC.
seoContent:
## Buy soundbars in Nepal

Modern TVs are slim, which leaves little room for good speakers. A soundbar fixes that: dialogue becomes clearer, music sounds fuller and movies and sports gain real impact, all from one slim unit under the TV.

## How to choose a soundbar

- Channels: 2.0 and 2.1 soundbars improve TV sound; 3.1 and above add a dedicated centre channel for clearer dialogue; 5.1 and Dolby Atmos models add surround effects
- Subwoofer: a separate wireless subwoofer adds deep bass for movies
- Connection: HDMI ARC or eARC lets your TV remote control the volume; optical and Bluetooth are alternatives
- Size: match the soundbar width to your TV for the best look
- Room size: larger rooms benefit from more power and a subwoofer

All soundbars we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: How do I connect a soundbar to my TV?
faqs.answer: The best way is HDMI ARC or eARC, which carries sound and lets you use the TV remote. If your TV does not have ARC, use an optical cable or Bluetooth.

faqs.question: Do I need a subwoofer?
faqs.answer: Not always. A subwoofer adds deep bass that makes movies and music more powerful. For news, dialogue and small rooms, a soundbar alone is often enough.

faqs.question: What is Dolby Atmos?
faqs.answer: Dolby Atmos is a surround sound format that adds height effects. Atmos soundbars use upward-firing or virtual speakers to make sound feel like it comes from above as well as around you.
